semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Werth Messtechnik GmbH provides high-precision coordinate measuring machines that are crucial for quality control in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Werth Messtechnik GmbH specializes in high-precision coordinate measuring machines (CMMs) that are vital for quality control in semiconductor manufacturing. Their systems, which include multisensor CMMs with optical sensors, tactile probes, and computed tomography, are customizable for various materials and measurement tasks.
